name: Grow With The Flow
source:
You’ve done everything you could to get your farm up and running, but nothing seems to be working, from sewing seeds to watering them. Maybe you’re just a bad farmer after all? But one day, a mysterious merchant offers you a miracle: in the form of a bag of fertilizer?! With nothing to lose, you sprinkle the fertilizer on the last of your crops in the hopes that they’ll sprout. 

You expected the results of the fertilizer to take months to take root, but you were in for a rude awakening. Right where you used your fertilizer, standing before you were five handsome personifications of your springtime crops! Determined to help you in your quest to run the farm, the plants(?) are eager to see you succeed, and eager to romance you. 

It’s up to you to decide who to romance and who to help around the farm, and more importantly, it’s up to you to see the farm flourish!

[edited, from [url=https://growwiththeflow.itch.io/grow-with-the-flow]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你已经竭尽全力让你的农场建立起来并运转起来，但似乎没有任何效果，从缝制种子到浇水。也许你毕竟只是一个坏农民？但有一天，一位神秘商人为你提供了一个奇迹：一袋肥料？！没有什么可损失的，你把肥料撒在最后一批庄稼上，希望它们能发芽。

你预计肥料的效果需要几个月才能生根，但你猛然醒悟。就在你施肥的地方，站在你面前的是五个英俊的春天作物的化身！植物（？）决心帮助你经营农场，渴望看到你成功，并渴望与你浪漫。

由你来决定与谁浪漫以及为谁提供农场周围的帮助，更重要的是，由你来决定农场的繁荣！

[编辑，来自 [url=https://growwiththeflow.itch.io/grow-with-the-flow]itch.io[/url]]
